referencePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production model sheet for one adult male game hero, HIRO. The attached image is the identity/costume reference, not the required composition; its face is blank because the original engine drew eyes and mouth, so paint a complete handsome mature face now with BROWN/HAZEL eyes, controlled brows, natural lips.
Paint THREE separate full-body views evenly across one wide landscape image on a perfectly flat pale neutral gray background, no text, labels, borders, cast shadows, set or extra people. First view: RIGHT-FACING side-on combat guard, katana drawn held diagonally low toward right; second: relaxed neutral three-quarter facing right, katana fully sheathed at LEFT hip; third: back three-quarter right-facing guard, rear costume and legs visible.
Identity: dark chocolate-brown skin; violet/purple locs tied into a high thick half-topknot with shoulder-length loose locs, silver cuffs, shaved sides, tiny violet glowing tech implant at left temple. Slim athletic adult masculine full-body proportions, about 7.5 heads tall. Exact reference outfit extended to legs: graphite black lacquered samurai lamellar cuirass with muted gold fittings and narrow violet glowing accents, black articulated shoulder plates and bracers, rich purple sash and split purple under-robe panels, black fitted trousers, plated shin guards and black split-toe armored boots. Slight cyberpunk styling in a fantasy samurai silhouette. One consistent long katana with clean silver blade, dark hilt/purple wrap, modest round bronze guard, black/purple scabbard worn at left waist. Keep arms/legs practical for swordplay. No modern gun.
Hand-painted HIGH-DETAIL anime illustration at reference fidelity: softly modeled dark skin, individually drawn locs, metallic lacquer highlights, fabric folds and gold fittings. Do not simplify to cel blocks or cartoon/chibi. Same height in each view, boots on one common baseline, generous padding around complete hair and sword. Eye-level side/three-quarter camera suitable for 2D game sprites, no low angles. Every limb, scabbard, sword tip fully inside its own third of sheet, do not overlap adjacent views. This is the golden model reference to match across all subsequent painted animation frames.
